description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Model::ProjectImporter' class, which contains business logic for importing project data from one project to another, including property management, validation, and data transfer methods.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::ProjectImporter
classes.description: A Moose-based class extending Catalyst::Model, encapsulating logic for importing project data, managing properties, and validating import operations.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Returns a deep clone of the list of public properties available for import.

methods.name: properties_json
methods.description: Returns a JSON-encoded string of the public properties.

methods.name: importable_properties
methods.description: Returns a list of properties that can be imported into a project based on its inventory.

methods.name: unimportable_properties
methods.description: Returns a list of properties that cannot be imported into a project based on its inventory.

methods.name: can_import_properties
methods.description: Checks if a given set of properties can be imported into a project, validating against existing data and dependencies.

methods.name: import_data
methods.description: Performs the import of specified properties from a source project to a target project, handling data transfer and ID translation.

methods.name: _validate_properties
methods.description: Validates that requested property keys are known and their dependencies are satisfied.
